Name: Miriam, Daughter of Ezra
Summary: Daughter borne to Ezra's line, named beside Shammai and Ishbah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:17: Daughter borne to Ezra's line, named beside Shammai and Ishbah.
LifeLesson: The mention of Miriam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
